teaser: A quick tour of the profile and the publishing workflow it is designed to support.
author: administrator
body:
A useful publishing system should get out of the way. This profile starts with a clear home page, a chronological journal and article pages that keep attention on the text.

Start with the structure

Edit the site title, navigation and footer, then replace the sample entries with your own. New children under the Journal node automatically appear in the blog list.

The layout is responsive and uses only Quanta's own templates and assets.
title: Welcome to the journal
